title: God Gives Hezekiah More Days
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and sees, and tonight Hezekiah is given a sign he can watch with his own eyes, the shadow going backward: Scout prays for sick Grandma, watches the sunny spot creep across the floor all afternoon, and whispers thank you when Grandma sits up at dinner.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because she looks closely for the ways Heavenly Father answers, and Hezekiah was given a sign he could see. In Scout’s world today: Grandma is sick in bed, so Scout prays for her before breakfast. All afternoon Scout watches the sunny spot creep across the kitchen floor. At dinner Grandma sits up and asks for soup, and Scout whispers thank you. Just like Hezekiah watching the shadow go backward, Scout learned that Heavenly Father hears our prayers, and we can look for His answers.
